title: Tool descriptor
description: An executable capability with a typed contract. Availability is not permission: a tool declares what it needs to be authorised for, and the authority engine decides. Every mutating tool must declare how it is undone, because an irreversible action discovered at execution time is discovered too late. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':'). Digest is sha256 over those bytes as 'sha256:<hex>'. Backward compatibility: additive optional fields are minor; removing a field, narrowing an enum or adding a required field is MAJOR and takes a new $id.

required_authority.description: What a grant must carry for this tool to be usable. Declared by the tool, decided by the engine.

rollback_tool.description: Required when destructive is true -- enforced by the validator, since JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express the conditional cleanly here.

timeout_seconds.description: A tool with no timeout is a tool that can hang a loop with no stop condition.

evidence.description: What the tool must emit to make its effect auditable. A mutating tool that produces no evidence leaves no trace to reconcile against.
